needs-a-human: the reported String/Long collection-binding exception path is already addressed on current main.

Inspected upstream a27b439b2dc96cf0bd0bf8f76ab33ff6d5664b25. QueryArguments.isInstance() calls JavaType.coerceOrNull(); a whole Collection returns null from StringJavaType.wrapOrNull() and LongJavaType.coerceOrNull(), so this path rejects scalar coercion without constructing the reported exception.

The existing fix is [HHH-20721, ce2ce9a48c](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/commit/ce2ce9a48cb28320d2e1c1bb35c32ea491480b0f), an ancestor of the inspected main. No new production change is justified for this reported path.

Blast radius would be hibernate-core query binding and Java type coercion; avoid changing Collection handling broadly because custom and plural basic mappings have different contracts. Two-way: this triage does not change code, public API, schema, or persisted data.

Jira remains New and Unassigned. All-state searches found no HHH-21077 PR; the prior source fix uses HHH-20721. No duplicates were closed.

This is source inspection, independently reviewed, not executable RED/GREEN evidence. No tests or builds were run. Behavior on the reported 7.4.13 line, custom JavaTypes, and backport eligibility remain unverified.
